```{r}
library(lubridate)


data_hua <- read.csv("C:/Users/AVITA/Downloads/花蓮縣公車.csv")
data_ttt <- read.csv("C:/Users/AVITA/Downloads/臺東縣公車.csv")

windowsFonts(yui = windowsFont("Microsoft JhengHei"))

years <- c(2023, 2024, 2025)


dir.create("C:/Users/AVITA/Downloads/花蓮縣市區客運搭車定期票長條圖", showWarnings = FALSE)

year_hua <- year(as.POSIXct(data_hua$資料代表日期.yyyy.MM.dd))
ticket_hua <- as.character(data_hua$票種次類型)

ticket_hua_new <- ifelse(grepl("HUA-399", ticket_hua), "花蓮399",
                  ifelse(grepl("HUA-199", ticket_hua), "花蓮199",
                         "非定期票"))

for (y in years) {

  data_y <- ticket_hua_new[year_hua == y]
  if(length(data_y) == 0) next

  result <- table(data_y)

  all_types <- c("花蓮399","花蓮199","非定期票")
  result <- result[all_types]
  result[is.na(result)] <- 0

  percent <- round(result / sum(result) * 100, 1)
  percent_label <- sprintf("%.1f%%", percent)

  order_index <- order(result, decreasing = TRUE)
  result <- result[order_index]
  percent_label <- percent_label[order_index]

  roc <- y - 1911

  png(paste0("C:/Users/AVITA/Downloads/花蓮縣市區客運搭車定期票長條圖/",
             roc,"年花蓮縣市區客運搭車定期票長條圖.png"),
      width=8, height=6, units="in", res=300)

  par(family="yui", mar=c(4,2,6,2), xpd=NA)

  bp <- barplot(result,
                col = gray.colors(length(result), 0.3, 0.9),
                axes = FALSE,
                border = "black",
                width = 0.3,
                space = 0.3)

  text(bp, result, labels = percent_label, pos = 3, cex = 1)

  title(main = paste0(roc,"年花蓮縣市區客運搭車定期票長條圖"), adj = 0.05)

  dev.off()
}


dir.create("C:/Users/AVITA/Downloads/臺東縣市區客運搭車定期票長條圖", showWarnings = FALSE)

year_ttt <- year(as.POSIXct(data_ttt$資料代表日期.yyyy.MM.dd))
ticket_ttt <- as.character(data_ttt$票種次類型)

ticket_ttt_new <- ifelse(grepl("TTT-299", ticket_ttt), "臺東299",
                        "非定期票")

for (y in years) {

  data_y <- ticket_ttt_new[year_ttt == y]
  if(length(data_y) == 0) next

  result <- table(data_y)

  all_types <- c("臺東299","非定期票")
  result <- result[all_types]
  result[is.na(result)] <- 0

  percent <- round(result / sum(result) * 100, 1)
  percent_label <- sprintf("%.1f%%", percent)

  order_index <- order(result, decreasing = TRUE)
  result <- result[order_index]
  percent_label <- percent_label[order_index]

  roc <- y - 1911

  png(paste0("C:/Users/AVITA/Downloads/臺東縣市區客運搭車定期票長條圖/",
             roc,"年臺東縣市區客運搭車定期票長條圖.png"),
      width=8, height=6, units="in", res=300)

  par(family="yui", mar=c(4,2,6,2), xpd=NA)

  bp <- barplot(result,
                col = gray.colors(length(result), 0.3, 0.9),
                axes = FALSE,
                border = "black",
                width = 0.01,
                space = 0.5)

  text(bp, result, labels = percent_label, pos = 3, cex = 1)

  title(main = paste0(roc,"年臺東縣市區客運搭車定期票長條圖"), adj = 0.05)
```
